meta.title: Try to purchase a line whose PR is waiting for approval or was sent back
gaps: Select a PR specifically identified as approval in progress or send-back pending; select_pr has no status filter or assertion for that state.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Select a PR specifically identified as approval in progress or send-back pending; select_pr has no status filter or assertion for that state.

plan.title: Block Purchase of Pending PR Line

steps.note: Use the Open tab where the Purchase Items entry point is expected.
Tick the available PR line to expose the Purchase Items control.
Verify that Purchase Items remains disabled.

args.text: Rejected or Send Back Pending PR cannot be purchased

steps.note: Verify the exact refusal reason shown to the buyer.
Attempt the prohibited purchase action and verify it is refused.
